title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Job Description – Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist

**Department:** Human Resources  
**Location:** Mumbai  
**Reporting To:** AGM – HR  
**Experience:** 4–8 Years

Role Purpose

To drive talent acquisition activities and support HR operations across the organization. The role will focus on workforce planning, talent sourcing and pipeline development, while also managing key HR operational activities to ensure smooth employee lifecycle management and consistent implementation of HR processes.

Key ResponsibilitiesA. Talent Acquisition – 60%

* **Talent Acquisition Planning:** Coordinate with department heads and project teams to understand current and future manpower requirements, prioritize vacancies and develop recruitment plans aligned with business needs.
* **Talent Mapping & Pipeline Development:** Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical positions through LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, recruitment consultants, networking and other sourcing channels.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:** Work closely with hiring managers to understand job requirements, finalize candidate profiles, coordinate interviews and obtain timely selection decisions.
* **End-to-End Recruitment:** Manage the recruitment cycle, including resume screening, initial candidate discussions, interview coordination, salary negotiations, offer release and joining follow-up.
* **Recruitment MIS & Analytics:** Maintain recruitment trackers and monitor vacancies, sourcing effectiveness, time-to-fill, offer acceptance and joining ratios. Share regular recruitment updates with HR management.

B. HR Operations – 40%

* **Employee Lifecycle Management:** Coordinate onboarding, joining formalities, employee documentation, induction and exit formalities to ensure a smooth employee experience.
* **Attendance, Leave & HRIS Management:** Monitor attendance and leave records, support the implementation of HR policies and ensure proper use of the FactoHR application and other HR systems.
* **HR Reporting & Employee Support:** Maintain employee records, prepare HR reports, support HR policy implementation and assist employees and managers with routine HR queries and operational requirements.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* **Qualification:** Graduate in any discipline; an MBA or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources will be an advantage.
* **Experience:** 4–8 years of experience in Talent Acquisition and HR Operations, preferably in construction, infrastructure, engineering or project-based organizations.
* **Talent Acquisition Expertise:** Experience in manpower planning, talent mapping, sourcing strategies, stakeholder coordination and end-to-end recruitment.
* **HR Operations Knowledge:** Practical experience in onboarding, employee documentation, attendance and leave management, HRIS and employee lifecycle processes.
* **Communication & Coordination:** Strong communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with hiring managers, employees, candidates and recruitment consultants.
* **Planning & Results Orientation:** Strong organizational, analytical and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage multiple recruitment requirements while ensuring accuracy and timely completion of HR operational activities.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹650,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

* What is your expected Salary ?
* Our office is in Narmiman Point Mumbai; Are you comfortable to work from this Location ?
* Your notice Period

Work Location: In person

**Location:** Bangalore – HSR Layout | **Experience:** 1–5 Years  
**Type:** Full-time | **Work Mode:** In-office

**About Quabrick - www.quabrick.com**

Quabrick is a boutique, Product-focused Executive Search firm working with high-growth startups and technology companies to build exceptional **Product, Engineering and Design leadership teams**.

We work on critical mandates ranging from **Director / Head of Product & Engineering to VP, CPO and CPTO**.

Our approach goes beyond resumes — we identify leaders who can genuinely shape products, teams and businesses. As a growing team, you will work closely with the founding team, get direct exposure to Executive Search and learn how senior Technology leaders are identified and evaluated.

**The Role**We are looking for a **high-energy Recruiter** who enjoys sourcing, solving search problems and discovering hard-to-find talent. You will work closely with the founding and delivery teams to identify, engage, evaluate and close talent across **Product, Engineering and Design** mandates.

Your journey will be: **Understand the mandate → Map the talent market → Source → Engage → Evaluate → Manage the process → CloseWhat You'll Do**

* Own searches from requirement understanding through candidate closure.
* Source exceptional talent through **LinkedIn, Naukri, X-Ray, referrals and other channels**.
* Build targeted talent pools, competitor maps and market intelligence.
* Identify and engage **passive candidates** for niche and leadership mandates.
* Conduct meaningful candidate screening beyond the resume.
* Partner closely with the founding team and hiring stakeholders.
* Manage multiple searches while maintaining a high-quality pipeline.
* Continuously improve sourcing techniques, market knowledge and recruitment skills.

**What We're Looking For**

* **1–5 years** of recruitment experience, preferably in **Technology hiring, Executive Search, startups or recruitment consulting**.
* Hands-on experience hiring **Engineering / Product / Design / Data / Technology** talent.
* Strong sourcing and Boolean search capabilities.
* Experience using **LinkedIn, Naukri, Instahyre or similar platforms**.
* Ability to identify and engage passive talent.
* Strong communication, candidate engagement and stakeholder-management skills.
* Curiosity to understand new technologies, products and businesses quickly.
* High ownership, resilience and a strong hunger to learn and grow.

**Why Quabrick?**

* Work directly on **high-impact Product, Engineering and Design searches**.
* Build relationships with **Founders, CXOs and senior Technology leaders**.
* Learn Executive Search, market mapping and leadership hiring hands-on.
* Exposure to startups, SaaS, technology and high-growth businesses.
* High ownership and autonomy in a growing firm.
* Clear career path: **Recruiter → Senior Recruiter → Search Consultant**.

**Who Will Thrive Here?**Someone who is **curious, competitive, coachable and hungry to grow** — someone who enjoys finding people others cannot find, solving search problems rather than simply posting jobs, and taking ownership of outcomes.**If you want to build a career in Executive Search and work with the people shaping India's next generation of technology companies, Quabrick is the place to do it.**

description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented HR Recruiter with 4 to 7 years of experience to manage the complete recruitment lifecycle. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, a strong network, and a proven ability to attract, engage and hire quality talent while delivering an outstanding candidate experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment, from requirement gathering to offer rollout and onboarding.

* Partner with hiring managers to understand manpower needs, role expectations and hiring timelines.

* Draft and publish job descriptions and source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed), social media, referrals and databases.

* Screen resumes, conduct telephonic and face-to-face interviews, and assess candidates on skills, experience and culture fit.

* Coordinate and schedule interview rounds, and collect timely feedback from interviewers.

* Negotiate compensation, roll out offer letters and follow up with candidates until joining to minimise drop-offs.

* Conduct reference and background verification checks.

* Maintain candidate pipelines, talent pools and recruitment data in the ATS / trackers.

* Prepare and share regular MIS reports on hiring status, time-to-fill and cost-per-hire.

* Build employer branding through job fairs, campus drives and networking events.

* Support onboarding and ensure a smooth joining experience for new hires.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree; MBA / PGDM in HR preferred.

* 4 to 7 years of proven experience in end-to-end recruitment (IT / Non-IT ).

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; knowledge of Telugu / Hindi is an added advantage.

* Strong sourcing skills, including Boolean search and use of job portals and LinkedIn Recruiter.

* Strong negotiation, interviewing and stakeholder management skills.

* Ability to handle multiple requirements and deliver within deadlines.

* Good working knowledge of ATS tools, MS Office and recruitment MIS.

* Positive attitude, professionalism and a high sense of ownership.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Candidates currently based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate immediately.

* Experience in a fast-paced, high-volume hiring environment.

* Women candidates are strongly encouraged to apply, including those returning to work after a career break.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

* Professional growth and learning opportunities.

* Supportive, inclusive and collaborative work culture.

title: DevOps Engineer - Hyderabad
description:
Join the T&L DevOps team, a collaborative and high-performing organization focused on innovation, reliability, automation, and continuous improvement across Deloitte. As a DevOps Engineer II, you will work with business, development, security, architecture, and operations teams to implement and support Azure-based solutions across a diverse application landscape.

This role is suited to a hands-on DevOps professional who can independently manage assigned technical activities, support cloud environments, improve CI/CD processes, troubleshoot complex issues, and contribute to the project’s AI vision roadmap. You will help implement secure, scalable, and well-documented solutions using Azure, infrastructure as code, automation, containers, monitoring, and AI-enabled services.

  
  

**Work you'll do**

As a DevOps Engineer II on the T&L DevOps team, you will be responsible for…

We are seeking an enthusiastic, passionate professional with experience in Azure cloud services and DevOps practices to lead and help us mature our DevOps practice across disciplines. You will have broad skills in implementing cloud solutions for various application architectures, scripting, databases and other data services ensuring the optimal level of documentation.

This role will implement and support cloud solutions on MS Azure and processes leveraged by large number of applications hosted in our environment. You will work with development teams to help increase automation and streamline build & deployment processes, apply best practices & principles. This role will engage with wider Deloitte Cloud and Security teams to ensure compliance and alignment with firm policy and assess impact of future strategies. You will design and support the growing demand for cloud technologies, including Kubernetes, Open AI, and implementations on Azure, creating & maintaining technical documentation for the Architects.

We are looking for individuals who are passionate about development, innovative and seek to continuously improve. We also expect you to comfortably transition between varying projects and priorities.

* **Azure Platform and Environment Support:** Monitors the T&L department’s tools and procedures and promotes their evolution alongside the business’s systems. He/She plays an active role in building and improving the platform services inclusive of websites, software, and applications while hosting and managing databases. Configure, deploy, and maintain Azure resources across development, testing, staging, and production environments. Support applications and services hosted on Azure Virtual Machines, App Services, Web Apps, Azure SQL, AKS, Azure Container Apps, and related platform services. Assist with onboarding and configuration of application, database, container, and data-service components. Maintain consistent environment configurations and support the setup of new environments. Contribute to scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure designs under established architecture and governance standards. Identify opportunities to optimize cloud resource utilization, AI service consumption, and operational costs while maintaining performance, availability, and reliability.
* **CI/CD and Infrastructure Automation:** Create, maintain, and monitor CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps. Support continuous integration, continuous testing, application deployment, and release-management activities. Develop and maintain automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, ARM templates, Terraform, or Bicep. Support infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, deployment validation, and recurring operational tasks. Maintain source-code repositories and branching processes using Git, Azure Repos, and TFVC. Contribute to repository and delivery-process migration from TFVC to Git.
* **Application Reliability and Technical Support:** Monitor application and infrastructure health using approved monitoring and observability tools. Investigate alerts, deployment failures, performance issues, connectivity problems, and service disruptions. Troubleshoot IIS, Azure API Management, Azure networking, firewall, NSG, and application connectivity issues. Resolve assigned incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs. Contribute to root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and preventive measures. Support production releases, environment maintenance, and operational handover activities. Experience with cloud resource optimization, FinOps practices, or cloud and AI cost management is desirable.
* **AI Enablement:** Support the deployment and operation of AI-enabled applications using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Document Intelligence, and related Azure services. Apply AIOps principles by leveraging monitoring data, automation, and AI-driven insights to proactively identify, investigate, and resolve incidents and improve platform reliability. Implement foundational integrations between enterprise applications and approved Azure AI services. Support AI workload using services such as Databricks, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Redis Cache, Azure SignalR, AKS, and Azure Container Registry. Assist with monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational support for AI-service integrations. Use approved AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, knowledge retrieval, and operational reporting. Validate AI-generated scripts, configurations, and recommendations before use in project environments. Identify opportunities to apply automation and AI to reduce manual effort and improve response times. Follow approved security, privacy, access, and data-handling practices when working with AI tools and services.
* **Security, Monitoring, and Governance:** Support the implementation of secure configurations for Azure resources, networking, access, secrets, and deployment processes. Assist with the integration and maintenance of code-quality, vulnerability, and security-scanning tools. Support monitoring solutions such as Application Insights, Azure Monitor, SolarWinds, Prometheus, and Grafana. Maintain accurate technical documentation, runbooks, configuration records, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting guides. Follow established engineering, security, change-management, and operational standards. Experience implementing advanced monitoring and observability capabilities, including dashboards, alerting, centralized logging, health checks, and proactive incident detection.
* **Collaboration and Continuous Improvement:** Work with Development, QA, Security, Infrastructure, Data, Architecture, and Operations teams to resolve technical dependencies. Share technical knowledge, reusable scripts, lessons learned, and operational improvements with the wider team. Adapt to changing priorities and contribute effectively across multiple projects and workstreams. Stay current with Azure, DevOps, automation, containerization, observability, and AI technology developments.
  

  

**The team**

At Deloitte, we’re all about collaboration. And nowhere is this more apparent than among our 2,000-strong internal services team. With our combined specialist skills, we provide all the essential support and advice our client-facing colleagues need, right across the firm. This enables them to focus all of their efforts on delivering the best service possible to their clients. Covering seven distinct areas; Human Resources, Clients & Industries, Finance & Legal, Practice Support Services, Quality & Risk Services, IT Services, and Workplace Services & Real Estate, together we live, breathe and deliver the Deloitte experience.

  
  

**Location: Hyderabad**

  
  

**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**

  
  

**Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor of Engineering/ Bachelor of Technology; 3 to 6 years’ experience in a similar role and Enterprise organisation.
* **Azure and DevOps:** Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and hands-on experience with Azure DevOps. Experience with Azure Virtual Machines, Azure SQL, App Services, Web Apps, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Apps, and Azure Container Registry. Working knowledge of Azure API Management, Application Gateway, Databricks, Azure Cosmos DB, Redis Cache, and Azure SignalR. Practical experience with CI/CD pipeline configuration, monitoring, deployment orchestration, and continuous testing. Experience with Git, Azure Repos, TFVC, and source-code management practices.
* **Automation and Infrastructure as Code:** Strong PowerShell and Azure CLI scripting skills. Working knowledge of ARM templates, Terraform, or Bicep. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, and Helm. Understanding of configuration management and environment provisioning.
* **Application, Networking, and Monitoring:** Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting IIS. Understanding of Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, firewalls, NSGs, service endpoints, and private endpoints. Experience troubleshooting application connectivity and network-related issues. Familiarity with Application Insights, Azure Monitor, SolarWinds, Prometheus, Grafana, or comparable tools. Exposure to SonarQube, Snyk, Fortify, or similar security and code-quality tools.
* **AI and Data Services:** Working knowledge of Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and Azure AI Document Intelligence. Understanding of basic integration patterns for connecting enterprise applications with Azure AI services. Ability to troubleshoot AI-service integrations and support AI-enabled application deployments. Familiarity with Azure SQL, Databricks, Cosmos DB, Redis Cache, or related data services.
* You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
* You can expect to co-locate on average 2 days times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.

  

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

. Manage difficult discussions constructively and build alignment across stakeholders with different priorities.  
. Support the Business Process Expert in resolving cross domain dependencies and design conflicts.

. Act as ARS's internal design authority for SAP MM, Procurement, Inventory Management and EWM.  
. Review and validate end to end designs proposed by the SI.

. Procure to pay processes

. Contracts, scheduling agreements and source determination  
. Inventory management and physical inventory  
. Goods receipt, goods issue and stock transfers

. Invoice verification and Finance integration

. Material master and organisational structures  
. Batch, serial number and traceability requirements  
. Embedded and decentralised EWM scenarios  
. Inbound, outbound and internal warehouse processes  
. Put away, picking, packing, staging and replenishment  
. Handling unit, warehouse task and warehouse order management  
. Production supply and receipt from production  
. RF and mobile warehouse operations  
. EWM integration with MM, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance

. Ability to review configuration, functional specifications, integration designs and enhancement requirements.  
. Proven experience reviewing and challenging System Integrator deliverables.  
. Understanding of master data, migration, testing, cutover and deployment.

* Partner with cybersecurity, application teams, server owners, and change management teams to design, test, and implement network changes in a controlled and pragmatic manner.
* Provide technical leadership across routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, wireless, firewalling, authentication, and access control domains.
* Support the evolution of enterprise and cloud networking patterns, including hybrid connectivity, governance, scalability, and performance optimization.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex network incidents, chronic issues, and cross-functional troubleshooting involving support, operations, and engineering teams.
* Create and maintain network diagrams, traffic flow maps, standards, SOPs, and implementation documentation.

* Mentor other engineers, influence technical direction, and help establish best practices that balance product agility with enterprise reliability and governance.

* 12+ years of hands-on experience in network engineering, network architecture, and production support in medium to large enterprise environments.
* Proven experience operating as a technical lead or senior engineer across both project delivery and business-as-usual support models.

* Strong background in core networking, including routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise wireless.
* Strong experience with VPN technologies, remote access architecture, firewall policy design, and network security controls.
* Experience leading or materially contributing to network segmentation, access control, and zero trust or trust-zone initiatives.

* Experience with Cisco, Meraki, Palo Alto, and/or Fortinet platforms.
* Experience with SD-WAN, SASE, ZTNA, and modern remote access patterns.
* Experience with cloud networking and hybrid connectivity across AWS and other public cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with automation or infrastructure-as-code approaches for network consistency, governance, and scale.
* Experience in traffic analysis, network visualization, and phased deployment planning.

* You provide clear technical leadership across architecture, modernization, and operational support.
* You improve the security and resilience of the network through better segmentation, access design, and lifecycle governance.
* You help modernize VPN and remote connectivity patterns while maintaining a strong user and operational experience.

**Profile summary**

We are seeking a seasoned network engineering leader who combines deep technical expertise with operational judgment and strong collaboration skills. You should be comfortable leading change, supporting critical production environments, and shaping network architecture that is secure, modern, scalable, and practical to operate day to day.

* You bridge product velocity and support stability, ensuring network services scale with business needs.
* You raise the technical maturity of the team through mentorship, documentation, standards, and execution discipline.

description:
As a member of the ShipBob Team, you will...

* **Grow with an Ownership Mindset**: We champion continuous learning and innovation. You'll take on real problems, create tangible solutions, and drive results that move the needle for ShipBob, our merchants, and for your own professional growth. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, this is the place.
* **Collaborate with Peers and Leaders Alike:** At ShipBob, leaders are accessible; feedback flows in both directions, and everyone, regardless of their seniority or role, steps up to help when needed. We hold each other to high standards because we trust each other to meet them. That combination of transparency and mutual respect is what makes the work here feel worth doing.
* **Experience a High-Performance Culture and Clear Purpose:** We are results-driven and clear about what that means: our goals are specific, accountability is shared, and every team member can see how their work connects to our mission. When we hit milestones, we celebrate them together. When we fall short, we learn and move forward.

**Location:** Remote in India

**Role Description:**

ShipBob is building a People Technology & Analytics function from the ground up, and this is the role that leads it.

Right now, our HR technology and people analytics capabilities exist, but they are distributed and not yet operating with a single coherent strategy. Core HCM lives in one place, Talent in another, Performance and OD systems in another, and a variety of other point system solutions throughout the People function. The data those systems generate is underutilized, integrations between them are inconsistent, and the opportunity to apply AI and automation thoughtfully across this landscape is full of opportunity. The goal for this role is to lead the efforts to close these gaps.

This is not an HRIS administration role nor a pure analytics function. You will lead building the operating model and function that ShipBob needs while doing meaningful technical work yourself along the way. If you are a player-coach who is energized by building something, who thinks in systems and roadmaps rather than tickets and configurations, and who has a genuine point of view on where AI creates real leverage in HR operations, this role was designed for you. This role reports to the Sr. Director, Total Rewards & HR Tech.

**What you'll do:**

* **People systems strategy and roadmap:** You are the strategic owner of how ShipBob thinks about its HR technology stack. That means making the build vs. buy calls, sequencing the investments, rationalizing what we have, and developing a point of view on what we need grounded in what the business requires. You will develop and maintain a People Technology & Analytics roadmap that reflects both near-term operational priorities and longer-term capability goals.
* **HR technology administration and architecture:** ShipBob's current stack includes ADP Workforce Now as core HCM, Greenhouse for recruiting, Lattice for performance and goal management, and a range of point solutions across the HR function. You will be responsible for the configuration strategy, integration architecture, and overseeing the ongoing administration of the full stack. You will also oversee and contribute toward building internal tooling and AI-powered workflows that close gaps.
* **People analytics program:** ShipBob does not yet have a structured people analytics capability. You will oversee development of data management, metric architecture, standard reporting cadences, and a roadmap of deeper workforce studies.
* **AI and automation strategy:** ShipBob is actively deploying AI agent tooling through our HR service center and enabling employees across the People team with access to AI-enabled tooling to build self-service solutions for process improvements and automations. You will partner with IT and People Leadership to develop a point of view on to drive long-term value in this space while avoiding redundancy and overspend.
* **Organizational design and team building:** You will assess the current state of People Technology & Analytics capability across ShipBob and develop a recommendation for what the right team structure looks like over the next 12 to 18 months. You will build the internal case for that structure and navigate the organizational dynamics required to bring it to life.
* **People Service Center partnership model:** ShipBob's People Service Center (PSC) is responsible for Tier 1 HR ticket resolution, data entry, and knowledge base management and operates adjacent to this function. This work is deeply intertwined with the systems and data this team owns. You will be accountable for defining a clear operating model for how PT&A and PSC work together: what each team owns, how they hand off, and how they complement each other.
* **Team leadership:** You will carry direct management responsibility for HRIS and analytics talent within this function and are expected to be an active, invested leader in developing the people on your team. As the function grows, so will your team. Building a culture of technical rigor, continuous learning, and high performance within People Technology & Analytics is part of the mandate.
* Other duties/responsibilities as necessary.

**What you'll bring to the table:**

* 8+ years in HR technology, HRIS, and people analytics, with at least 3 years in a formal leadership or team management role
* Direct experience with multiple HCM platforms across your career, not just deep expertise in one. You should be able to speak fluently about at least two to three different platforms and articulate how you evaluate which system is right for a given context.
* A demonstrated track record of operating as a player-coach: managing a team while personally owning meaningful technical deliverables.
* Experience developing and owning an HR technology roadmap, including build vs. buy decisions, vendor selection, and sequencing logic.
* Experience navigating organizational influence, driving technology change or consolidation with stakeholders who did not report to you and had their own stake in the current state.
* Independent people analytics capability: you can build a metrics framework, design a workforce study, or interpret a complex dataset without a dedicated analyst doing the work for you.
* Genuine curiosity and a specific point of view on how AI and automation apply to HR systems and operations.

**Strongly preferred**

* ADP Workforce Now, Greenhouse, and Lattice experience at an implementation or deep administration level

**Preferred**

* Experience at a multi-site, operationally complex company with both corporate and hourly/warehouse employee populations — logistics, manufacturing, distribution, or similar
* Exposure to agentic AI platforms, workflow automation tooling, or no-code/low-code build environments applied to HR workflows
* Experience building an org design case and presenting headcount recommendations to senior leadership
* This role requires a work schedule that covers at minimum 10am–2pm US Eastern time daily

* Public Holiday: 12 days
* Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave
* Quarterly Wellness Day

If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.

**About You:**

Building the world's leading full-stack fulfillment platform is challenging work. The problems we solve are complex, the pace is fast, and the bar is high. That means ShipBob's environment isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's okay. If you are ready to take ownership, push boundaries, and grow alongside a team that genuinely supports each other, we would love to hear from you.

**About Us:**

Merchants can outsource their entire fulfillment operations, utilize ShipBob's proprietary warehouse management system for in-house fulfillment, or take advantage of a hybrid solution across ShipBob's dozens of fulfillment center network in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia. **Data Protection - Product Compliance - Consultant**

Deloitte's Regulatory, Risk & Forensic practice helps clients turn evolving regulatory and risk requirements into practical action. Deloitte's Data and Digital Trust practice helps clients use data responsibly while safeguarding privacy, security, and digital trust. * Experience with artificial intelligence (AI) governance, age assurance and youth safety, or product data, identity, and access governance for digital products.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- SailPoint IIQ Senior**
===============================================

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**About Global Delivery Services**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**The Opportunity**

We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis

In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.

  

As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* 3-6 years of experience in designing and deploying IIQ-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions
* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.
* Should have experience in implementing at least one complete IAM SDLC engagements projects. This must include activities such as requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and application support
* Must have experience in SailPoint IIQ & IDN architecture, design, development, configuration, testing, integration, and deployment.
* Must have experience in source/ Identity profile configuration, transform/rule development, workflow configuration, JML process and certification, Password sync.
* Must have experience in onboarding AD, JDBC and web service applications to IIQ/IDN
* Must have experience in deployment of virtual appliance, understanding different VA architecture, deploy rules in cloud/VA, High availability/DR configuration
* Configuration and deployment of IQService in cloud and on-prem environments
* Must have hands on experience in configuring quick link, custom work flow, reports, developing service account management modules, integration with other tools like Service Now, CyberArk etc and plugin development
* IIQ Installation, set up and initial configuration/ upgradation to different versions of IIQ, Standard service build set up and configuration
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

**How to Apply**: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

  
  

The Senior Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) Engineer is a Bangalore-based, hybrid, hands-on senior individual contributor responsible for supporting, maintaining, configuring, and enhancing warehouse management capabilities across North America Distribution Centers and Converse ELC in Belgium. Working under the direction of the WMS Lead, this role provides advanced L2/L3 technical support for Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform) and related applications. **WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**

  
  

* Provide L3 technical support for Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform) and related supply chain applications, following established support and escalation processes.

* Troubleshoot complex incidents affecting receiving, putaway, inventory management, replenishment, wave planning, picking, packing, shipping, returns, and value-added services.

* Support warehouse initiatives, customer or process onboarding, automation changes, and omnichannel capabilities

through configuration, testing, deployment, and hypercare activities.

* Maintain WMS configuration records, technical documentation, process flows, support runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.

* Monitor and support integrations between WMS, SAP, order management, transportation systems, automation platforms, carrier solutions, and reporting services.

* Investigate interface failures, inventory synchronization issues, transaction errors, data mismatches, and batch- processing exceptions, escalating design or ownership decisions when needed.

* Perform operational validation and data reconciliation to help protect inventory accuracy and process continuity across connected systems.

* Work with integration and infrastructure specialists on assigned reliability, monitoring, performance, and recovery improvements.

* Support Manhattan SCI (IBM Cognos) reporting capabilities used by warehouse operations.

* Create, modify, validate, and troubleshoot approved operational reports, queries, and data extracts.

* Investigate reporting discrepancies and data-quality issues and document the identified cause and resolution.

* Work with stakeholders and the WMS Lead to clarify reporting needs and translate approved requirements into reliable reports.

* Prepare and execute SIT and UAT support, deployment checklists, production validation, go-live support, hypercare, and stabilization activities.

* Provide technical guidance to L1/L2 support analysts and share knowledge that improves first-contact diagnosis and resolution.

* Create and maintain vendor support cases, provide required diagnostic evidence, track progress, and escalate blockers through the WMS Lead.

* Contribute technical findings and improvement recommendations to incident reviews, problem management, service improvement, and modernization initiatives.

  
  

Role Requirements

* Strong L2/L3 application support expertise, including incident triage, technical diagnosis, production recovery, root- cause analysis, and problem management.

* Working knowledge of IBM i operations relevant to application support, such as job logs, job queues, output queues, scheduled jobs, libraries, files, and batch processing.

* Explore future opportunities to responsibly apply AI and intelligent automation to improve WMS reliability, proactive issue detection, operational efficiency, and warehouse decision-making.

* Strong SQL and database analysis skills for investigating operational issues, validating transactions, and supporting data reconciliation.

* Experience troubleshooting integrations and data synchronization across WMS, SAP, order management, transportation, automation, carrier, and reporting platforms.

* Strong understanding of warehouse processes, including receiving, putaway, inventory management, cycle counting, replenishment, wave planning, picking, packing, shipping, returns, VAS, and omnichannel fulfillment.

* Ability to execute approved technical changes independently while escalating architecture, priority, scope, and risk decisions to the WMS Lead.

* Experience supporting testing, deployment, production validation, hypercare, and operational handover activities.

* Experience working directly with Distribution Center Operations in a high-priority production support environment.

* Clear technical documentation, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

* Ability to manage multiple assigned priorities across regions and time zones while maintaining reliable delivery and support.

* Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and planned production activities outside standard business hours when required.

title: Founding Business Director
description:
**Founding Business Director – Finance & AI**

**Nebula Finance AI | Bangalore, India**

**Employment type:** Full-time, following a six-month probationary period  
**Location:** Kannur, Kerala, India  
**Expected office launch:** January 2027  
**Reporting to:** Founder  
**Travel:** Regular domestic travel, with potential international travel  
**Future mobility:** Willingness to relocate to other metros and international location as the business matures.

**About Nebula Finance AI**

Nebula Finance AI is an emerging financial technology company building an AI-powered finance workflow and intelligence platform for corporate clients in India.

Developed by AI engineers from Great Britain, our platform is designed to transform how corporate finance and treasury teams manage financial workflows, access insights, evaluate financial decisions, and automate repetitive processes.

Our solutions focus on practical applications across corporate treasury and finance, including cash and liquidity management, foreign exchange exposure and hedging, debt management, investments, receivables analysis, and AI-assisted financial decision-making.

By connecting financial data, business systems, banking workflows, and AI-powered intelligence, Nebula aims to help organisations improve efficiency, visibility, risk management, and the quality of financial decisions.

We have completed pilot testing with two major corporate organisations in India and are preparing to commence commercial operations. We are now establishing our first Indian office in Kannur, Kerala, with a planned launch in January 2027.

This is an opportunity to join Nebula at its earliest stage and help shape its commercial journey from the ground up.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly versatile, commercially minded and technology-oriented **Founding Business Director** to work directly with the Founder based in the UK.

The successful candidate will bring in **16-20 years of enterprise sales experience, closing large value enterprise solutions.** The person will have experience dealing with SAP, Oracle solutions and will be a well-known name in the market place.

The person will play a central role in developing client relationships, identifying business opportunities, demonstrating our technology, understanding customer requirements, and supporting the implementation and commercial growth of the Nebula platform.

As our first employee in India, you will have significant exposure to the Founder, senior corporate decision-makers, and the development of a growing AI-finance business.

The ideal candidate will combine a sound understanding of corporate finance and treasury with excellent communication skills, commercial awareness, technological curiosity, and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Corporate Client Acquisition and Relationship Management**

* Identify and develop business opportunities with large Indian corporates, including organisations with complex finance and treasury operations.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with Chief Financial Officers (CFOs), Chief Executive Officers (CEOs), Treasurers, Finance Directors, and other senior decision-makers.
* Research target organisations, understand their business models, and identify opportunities where Nebula's solutions can create measurable value.
* Arrange client meetings, introduce the platform, follow up on opportunities, and support the conversion of prospects into paying customers.
* Maintain a structured pipeline of prospects, meetings, demonstrations, proposals, and commercial opportunities.

**2. Platform Demonstrations and Solution Development**

* Develop a thorough understanding of the Nebula Finance AI platform, its modules, and its business applications.
* Conduct product demonstrations for prospective clients, including senior finance executives and corporate treasury teams.
* Understand customer requirements and translate business problems into practical technology use cases.
* Work with the Founder and technical team to communicate client feedback, refine demonstrations, and support the development of new features.
* Assist in preparing presentations, proposals, business cases, product documentation, and client-specific solution designs.

**3. Corporate Finance and Treasury**

* Develop a detailed understanding of corporate finance and treasury workflows, including cash management, liquidity forecasting, FX exposure, hedging, investments, debt management, and receivables.
* Understand how corporate finance teams interact with banks, ERP systems, financial data, and internal approval processes.
* Help identify opportunities to automate manual workflows and improve financial visibility through AI.
* Participate in discussions with client finance teams to understand existing processes and demonstrate how Nebula can improve them.

**4. Technology and AI Applications**

* Develop a working understanding of the technical architecture and capabilities of the Nebula platform.
* Demonstrate technological curiosity and an ability to understand how software applications, APIs, databases, AI models, and ERP integrations work.
* Work with the technical team to translate client requirements into clear functional specifications.
* Support platform testing, troubleshooting, user onboarding, and the preparation of user guides.
* Contribute to the development of practical AI-powered workflows for corporate finance.

**A strong interest in coding and software development is essential.** Candidates who can read or write basic code, understand APIs, work with data, or build simple technical demonstrations will have an advantage.

**5. Commercial Operations and Business Development**

* Support the Founder in preparing commercial proposals, pricing discussions, presentations, and client engagement strategies.
* Conduct market research to identify prospective customers, competitors, industry trends, and emerging opportunities in corporate finance technology.
* Maintain accurate records of client interactions, sales opportunities, and follow-up actions using a CRM or other business tools.
* Assist with client onboarding, implementation coordination, training, and ongoing relationship management.
* Help establish the processes, standards, and operating practices required to build Nebula's first Indian office.

**6. Founder’s Office and Strategic Projects**

* Work directly with the Founder on business development, strategic initiatives, operational planning, and market expansion.
* Take ownership of projects from initial research through execution and follow-up.
* Prepare concise reports, market assessments, meeting notes, and management updates.
* Represent Nebula professionally in client meetings, industry events, and business discussions.
* Be prepared to take on responsibilities beyond a conventional job description as the company evolves.

**Essential Qualifications and Experience**

* **16- 20 years of enterprise sales solution experience with a demonstrated history of the being a top-performer in the industry**.
* A well-known name in the market place and a thorough understanding of the gap in SAP and Oracle ERP Solutions with **a portfolio of client which could be moved**.
* Ability to onboard a few clients during the probationary period and proving his ability to catapult Nebula to greater heights in Indian and GCC markets.
* **Apart from a senior ERP sales consultant, senior banker, corporate advisor, retired CFO, ex-auditor etc will act as a strong candidate for the role.**
* A bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* An MBA in Finance, Business Management, or a related field is preferred.
* A strong understanding of corporate finance, treasury, financial markets, or business financial operations.
* Excellent spoken and written English. This is a non-negotiable requirement, given the role's direct interaction with senior corporate executives.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, communication, and client-management skills.
* A good understanding of coding and software development concepts, with the ability to engage confidently with technical teams.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand complex business problems.
* A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to work independently.
* Willingness to travel regularly to major Indian cities based on client and business requirements.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

The following would be advantageous:

* Experience in corporate treasury, banking, financial services, fintech, enterprise software, or B2B technology sales.
* Exposure to FX markets, derivatives, hedging, liquidity management, investments, or debt financing.
* Experience engaging with CFOs, Treasurers, Finance Directors, or other senior corporate stakeholders.
* Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP, financial software, APIs, databases, or business intelligence tools.
* Basic programming experience in Python, JavaScript, SQL, or similar languages.
* Familiarity with AI tools, large language models (LLMs), automation, or workflow software.
* Experience preparing business presentations, conducting product demonstrations, and developing commercial proposals.

Candidates with a strong combination of finance knowledge, technical aptitude, communication skills, and commercial potential will be considered even if they do not meet every preferred criterion.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who:

* Thinks like a business owner rather than someone who simply completes assigned tasks.
* Is comfortable speaking with senior executives and presenting complex concepts clearly.
* Can understand both the financial problem and the technological solution.
* Learns quickly, asks intelligent questions, and takes initiative.
* Is comfortable working in an early-stage startup where responsibilities evolve.
* Can manage multiple priorities while maintaining professionalism and attention to detail.
* Values confidentiality, integrity, accountability, and long-term client relationships.
* Is ambitious about building a career at the intersection of finance, AI, and enterprise technology.

**Employment Structure**

The role will begin with a **six-month probationary period**. Subject to satisfactory performance and the agreed employment terms, the position will continue as a full-time role.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Founder during the company's initial commercial expansion. As Nebula grows, there will be opportunities to assume greater responsibility across business development, client solutions, commercial operations, and regional expansion.

Compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, experience, and suitability for the role. Any performance-linked incentives or other benefits will be communicated during the recruitment process.

**Why Join Nebula Finance AI?**

* **Founding-team opportunity:** Become the first employee in our Indian operations and contribute directly to building the business.
* **Direct exposure to leadership:** Work closely with the Founder and participate in strategic and commercial decisions.
* **Enterprise technology exposure:** Gain practical experience in AI-powered financial workflows, enterprise software, and corporate treasury.
* **Senior client engagement:** Work with CFOs, CEOs, Treasurers, and other senior decision-makers.
* **Ownership and responsibility:** Take the lead on meaningful projects rather than being restricted to a narrow job function.
* **Career growth:** Develop towards leadership responsibilities as the business expands in India and internationally.
* **Geographic mobility:** Potential opportunities to work from other Indian cities or Dubai as the business develops.

**Application Process**

Interested candidates should submit the following:

* An updated CV/resume.
* A recent passport-size photograph.
* A brief cover note explaining their interest in Nebula Finance AI and why they are suited to a founding-team role.
* Details of relevant finance, technology, coding, client-facing, or business development experience.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a written English communication assessment, a finance or treasury case study, a basic technical aptitude assessment, and a product demonstration or business presentation exercise.

**To apply:** Submit your application through the recruitment channel specified in the job advertisement.

**Nebula Finance AI**  
*Building the future of corporate finance through artificial intelligence.*

* Manage and coordinate certain internal strategic initiatives across the Managed Services practice working closely with Sr Managers and Managers and providing updates to practice leads and rest of the organization as appropriate.

Mentor and coach Engagement Teams:

* Establish and set the tone for developing strong, inclusive mentoring and coaching relationships on the engagement, across all staff levels.

* Set the tone and encourage personal development on the engagement (i.e. encourage attendance of AMLRS trainings and personal development events and initiatives)

* Partner with Shared Service teams to address human capital and information technology related needs.
